en.clipped: It clipped: lower the gain. Tap to clear.
en.micDenied: Without microphone permission it cannot record. You can allow it in the phone settings.
en.formatHint.WAV24: Lossless, the highest quality. About 17 MB per minute in stereo.
en.formatHint.WAV16: Lossless, CD quality. About 11 MB per minute in stereo.
en.formatHint.AAC: Compressed, nearly indistinguishable from the original. About 2 MB per minute.
en.deviceGone: The chosen microphone is not connected.
en.deleteText: "{name}" is deleted from this phone and cannot be recovered.
en.err.unsupported-format: This phone does not record with that format, sample rate and channels. Try another in Settings.
en.err.mic-unavailable: Could not open the microphone with these settings. Try another combination in Settings.
en.err.mic-busy: Another app is using the microphone.
en.err.device-gone: The chosen microphone is not connected. Pick another in Settings.
en.err.device-refused: The phone does not allow using the chosen microphone.
en.err.read-failed: Reading from the microphone stopped ({detail}). What was recorded up to then is saved.
en.err.wav-full: A WAV reached its maximum size (4 GB). What was recorded is saved; start another recording.
en.err.close-failed: Could not close the file properly. The end of the recording may be damaged.
en.err.io: Could not write the recording ({detail}). Is there space left? What was recorded up to then is saved.
en.syncNote: Saving your recordings to your computer
en.syncWaitDirect: It will be copied when your phone and computer can connect directly
en.syncNeeded: Not copied to your computer yet. Tap to copy
en.syncAskText: There is no direct connection to your computer. The copy will go encrypted through your own server, and you pay for the traffic.
en.syncFailed: Could not copy it ({code}). Tap to try again
en.web.devNeedPermission: Microphone names appear after you allow the microphone.
en.web.micDenied: Without microphone permission it cannot record. You can allow it in the browser settings.
en.web.formatHint.AAC: Compressed (AAC 256 kbps), nearly indistinguishable from the original. About 2 MB per minute.
en.web.formatHint.OPUS: Compressed (Opus 192 kbps), nearly indistinguishable from the original. About 1.4 MB per minute. This browser does not compress to AAC.
en.web.compressedNone: This browser cannot record compressed. Use WAV.
en.web.srcHintVoice: The browser removes echo and noise and adjusts the volume by itself. Good for speech; it changes the sound.
en.web.srcHintUnprocessed: No echo or noise removal and no volume adjustment: what the microphone picks up.
en.web.storeProblem: Your storage could not be opened: the list of recordings is not being saved for now. The files do stay in this browser and come back to the list when you open it.
en.web.noStorage: This browser does not allow saving files here (a private window?), so it cannot record.
en.web.otherDevice: the file is not in this browser
en.web.deleteText: "{name}" is deleted from this browser and cannot be recovered.
en.web.keepOpen: Keep this tab open while recording.
en.web.err.unsupported-format: This browser does not record with that format, sample rate and channels. Try another in Settings.
en.web.err.device-refused: The browser does not allow using the chosen microphone.
en.web.err.mic-denied: Without microphone permission it cannot record. You can allow it in the browser settings.
en.web.err.no-storage: This browser does not allow saving files here (a private window?), so it cannot record.
